prompt:
Generate a NEW transparent four-view combat equipment sprite study FROM SCRATCH. Attached native FFT weapon atlas is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Do not copy its arrangement or any vanilla item. Severe native visual economy: small readable silhouettes, UNIFORM square pixel grid, a FEW large flat opaque muted color clusters, only 2 or 3 hard-edged shades per material. Like a tiny low-resolution tactical RPG battle sprite enlarged by nearest-neighbour, not a detailed inventory illustration. Four isolated views of ONE SAME physical object in 2x2 arrangement, HUGE truly transparent gutters. All equipment visible fully, away from sheet edges. Outside hard-edged silhouettes alpha ZERO. No background, vignette, checkerboard, text, labels, characters, hands, grain, noise or painterly rendering. ABSOLUTELY NO glow, halo, aura, haze, cloud, particles, translucent shadow, lighting spill, gradients or bloom. Omit ALL mist/smoke/magical effects even if mentioned in the object's signature: those are separate effects, not part of this sprite. Keep proportions/materials/design consistent in all four views. Simplify ornament to one readable distinctive feature rather than adding detail. No generic golden filigree. This is an art study, not a native engine atlas or encoded asset.
Equipment family: Bag. Object identity: One small soft ash-blue linen bag tied with plum cord, one empty open square iron clasp attached to flap, a torn white stitched patch and short carrying loop.
Palette identity: ash blue, plum, white.
Upper-left front tilted left, upper-right front tilted right; lower-left rear tilted left, lower-right rear tilted right. Preserve loop/strap and physical flap/patches; no new markings on rear.
review: Ash-blue pouch, plum cord, empty square clasp and stitched white patch retained; proposed plain rear is artistic.
